banner.title: agent-readonly
banner.tagline: The read-only identity agent sessions use to inspect the cluster: the built-in view role, plus cluster-scoped and infra CRD reads, with no Secrets.

steps.title: Identity
steps.text: A ServiceAccount named agent-readonly in kube-system. It has no Secret access and no pod exec rights.
steps.scene: a badge card on a neutral pedestal

steps.title: View
steps.text: A ClusterRoleBinding attaches the built-in view role. That covers namespaced reads, and view leaves Secrets out.
steps.scene: a lens over a row of namespace blocks

steps.title: Extras
steps.text: agent-readonly-extra adds get, list and watch on nodes, PVs, CRDs and the infra API groups the agents debug.
steps.scene: an extra panel slotting onto the view panel

steps.title: Mint
steps.text: scripts/agent-credentials.sh mints a short-lived token for this account into the agent kubeconfig. Git holds no token.
steps.scene: a sealed token cylinder outside a locked vault
